design_findings.change: Reconcile normative B0.7, DESIGN 8.4, B4 tiles, B8 gate algorithm, B10 gate rows, B11 promises, mutation specifications and the machine twin. State branch-sensitive payload rules that permit the existing False-variant rejection diagnostic after its discriminant test. State the sole WF-X finalization O assignment exception with exact exclusive assignments before its test. Preserve A1, diagnostics, codes, write order and the accepted domain.
design_findings.reason: B0.7 requires every non-discriminant selection after the entire gate and forbids every acceptance-object assignment. G16a instead selects FA.Rejected_Position inside its rejection gate, after testing FA.Ok; finalization O is necessarily assigned on the two exclusive paths. B8 implements the different after-test/assigned-exception rule. These are contradictory normative specifications, so O4/R-W/B4/B8 alignment is not closed.

design_findings.change: Complete the fully expanded naming invariant for indirect package paths admitted by the scoped inventory, including F.P.Decide and paths through the transport package qualifier. Define deterministic path-aware exclusion or an exact per-call expanded-qualifier invariant, and specify matching indirect-path mutation controls. Do not weaken V7/O6(a) or relax the scoped inventory.
design_findings.reason: The B9.4 list and B8 pattern cover simple alias.routine spellings. The pattern excludes a match preceded by a dot and does not enumerate F.P.Decide, although the permitted F renaming exposes P through Evaluation_Finalization.P -> Evaluation_Completion.P -> Evaluation_Pending. Exact current tiles/residual identity protect current text, but the claimed independent invariant for later reviewed tile amendments is stronger than this checking specification.
